body:
Found in an independent adversarial review of #683 (head `8f837d505b948a25965b0b2a001a4c7691c840fc`). Latent: no uppercase `kgmicrobe.*` objects exist in the current canonical TSV.

**Where:** `scripts/build_mim_ingredient_sssom.py`, B1 skip check (around L919–927 at the PR head).

**What happens:** membership against `registry_ids` is compared exactly, while Rule B5 casefolds the slug. Probe at the PR head: identifier `kgmicrobe.ingredient:MES_Buffer` with a CHEBI parent emits `kgmicrobe.ingredient:MES_Buffer` plus `kgmicrobe.compound:mes_buffer`, which fails B5.

**Suggested fix:** compare the object's local part casefolded (consistent with B5), or take the namespace from any curated `kgmicrobe.*` identifier; add a regression test with a mixed-case identifier.
title: MIM SSSOM B1 skip check is case-sensitive while Rule B5 casefolds slugs
